'''High Touch! 2009''' (Japanese: '''ハイタッチ！2009''' ''High Touch! 2009'') (ZMCP-4911) is a CD that was released in Japan on July 15, 2009. It features the fourth opening and ending of ''[[Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl]]'', along with some songs from ''[[M12|Arceus and the Jewel of Life]]''.
